Kansas State has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than Pittsburg State, Washburn and Emporia State combined.

Every Kansas college with 5,000+ students:

1. Kansas State: 52
2. Pittsburg State: 20
3. Washburn: 15
4. Emporia State: 13
5. Kansas: 11
6. Fort Hays State: 8
7. Wichita State: 7

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/ks
